audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side and phases[1].side read 'Skill' while win[0] and win[1] read 'Orianna'; phases[3].side read 'Skill' while win[3] read 'Taliyah'. Three cross-layer disagreements, and all seven whys were Orianna boilerplate misgendering her as 'he'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Unraveled Earth detonating only on dashes or on being knocked through — was never stated, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit.
audit.why: Riot's text: the minefield's mines explode and stun if enemies dash through it or are knocked through it. That makes Seismic Shove (14/12.5/11/9.5/8) the trigger and sidestepping the shove the whole answer.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[2].text and breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 23 fields misgendered Taliyah as he/his, and two bullets were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed; both bleed bullets replaced with kit-grounded content matching their titles.

audit.why: The packet flagged wants.foe[2] 'Use Weaver's Wall' as a probable wrong ability name at distance 4 — it is a false positive; Weaver's Wall is Taliyah's real R in the kit file. No edit made.
